run_agent_AIAgent: run the AIAgent class to execute a conversation loop with an LLM provider and tools
run_agent_strip_think_blocks: strip <think> and <thought> reasoning blocks from LLM assistant content while preserving visible text
run_agent_extract_reasoning: extract reasoning content from API response messages across reasoning, reasoning_content, and reasoning_details fields
run_agent_build_system_prompt: build a system prompt for the agent with identity, tool guidance, memory instructions, and datetime
run_agent_execute_tool_calls: execute tool calls from an LLM response sequentially or concurrently based on tool types and path overlap
run_agent_build_api_kwargs: build provider-specific API kwargs including model, messages, reasoning config, max tokens, and extra body params
run_agent_streaming_api_call: stream API responses chunk by chunk, assembling content and tool call arguments with interruption support
run_agent_run_conversation: run the main conversation loop with retry logic, compression, fallback providers, and credential recovery
run_agent_recover_credential_pool: recover from API errors by rotating credentials in the pool based on HTTP status codes and billing reasons
run_agent_normalize_codex_response: normalize Codex Responses API output by converting dict tool arguments to valid JSON strings
